#: mp_mul_d(a, b, a) in place growing a: mmuldg.asm.json with the destination the source; the row reads a->dp[ix] from the overlay (the grown block's digits, a's above the row).
opens: open Tom.Machine.Api.MulDGA (P lay kind isW ws Res)

edge.DG{i:=ix}: ⟨by rw [← congrFun hg.digit ix]; exact ((_h.dig (nR .aD) rfl).arr ix (by omega)).trans (by simp only [ovl, Nat.lt_irrefl, if_false]), hdl, Ram.sub (_h.dig (nR .aD) rfl).ram (by omega) (by omega)⟩

edge.rx: ⟨by rd_out, by rd_out, by rd_out, by rd_out, by rd_out, by rd_out, by rd_out⟩

prelude: have hst := hres.stk; have := hst.lo; have := hst.al; have := hst.hi
have hsa := hres.sa; have := hsa.used_le; have := hsa.alloc_lt; have hsc := hres.sc; have := hsc.used_le; have := hsc.alloc_lt
have hsz := hres.size_lt; have := hres.cpos; have hbr : b < 268435456 := hres.hb
have hsg : a.sign < 2 ^ 31 := by rcases hres.asign with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> decide
have eE : heapEnd = 0x87800000 := rfl; have eF : Api.MulDGA.F = 624 := rfl; have eB : mpMulDBase = 0x800019fc := rfl; have eG : MpGrow.F = 544 := rfl
have eTB : textBase = 0x80000000 := rfl; have eTL : textLen = 0x18880 := rfl; have eS : heapStart = 0x80019d10 := rfl
have hR : RamH (sp - 80) 80 := ⟨Ram.sub (hB .stk).2 (by simp only [lay, eF]; omega) (by simp only [lay, eF]; omega)⟩
have hpc := hS .cS .stk (by decide); have hco := hS .stk .code (by decide); have hcc := hS .cS .code (by decide); have hpa := hS .aS .stk (by decide)
simp only [Iv.Disj, Disj, lay, eF, textIv] at hpc hco hcc hpa

let.SG: { A with used := a.used, sign := a.sign }

dead: exact absurd (show A.used ≤ ix + 1 by omega) hn
